project_reference.core_research_question: Where can delegated software execution break the principal-to-mandate-to-authorization-to-settlement chain, and what evidence is required to demonstrate detection or intervention value?

scope.question: Audit the existing construct and define a falsifiable, evidence-vector-bound agentic-payment research program.

context_gaps: Historical transaction derivatives lost distinct events
No verified autonomous-execution or financial-crime outcome labels
No banking data or independently adjudicated outcomes

observables.name: Historical ERC-8004 registry owner/default-wallet proxy
observables.definition: Historical registry-record (R) association only; W,S,A,C,P,Y,H unknown

observables.name: Mandate-to-settlement evidence
observables.definition: Controller, mandate, provenance, authorization, settlement, and outcome evidence

deliverables.description: Causal roles, boundaries, planes, mechanisms, and falsifiers
Supported, exploratory, withdrawn, and untested claims

claims.statement: Unauthorized-loss risk arises when mandate, provenance, tool/wallet authorization, or settlement controls fail; automation changes amplification, not the definition of fraud.
The historical artifacts permit only exploratory registry-proxy versus unknown-counterparty ranking.

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-causal
acceptance_tests.procedure: Map every retained causal element to an observation and falsifier.

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
acceptance_tests.procedure: Recompute historical metrics and defect counts.

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-proxy-ranking
acceptance_tests.procedure: Audit authoritative artifacts against the claim ledger.
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Unsupported claims are withdrawn or future-tense.

unvalidated_assumptions: Verified autonomous cohorts will exhibit a material model interaction
Mandate and provenance controls will reduce realized loss
competing_explanations: Observed ranking is registry selection or service-type structure rather than autonomy
Existing actor-agnostic controls may already capture the relevant harm
disconfirming_observations: No executor-class interaction on an untouched matched cohort
No incremental lift or harm reduction over incumbent controls

position.last_activity_desc: Construct, code, manuscript, data-lineage, and GPD state repaired; fresh gates pending.

intermediate_results.summary: Historical composite AUC 0.514719 (reproduced by the preserved audit). Post-hoc AUC 0.622281 and random-address cross-fit AUC 0.612179 are provisional until preserved in an immutable end-to-end run manifest (AEF-C006).
Hash-only deduplication discarded at least 10,626 distinct observed event tuples.
Historical 82 unique senders versus 689 corrected sender-instance identities.

open_questions: Can an event-complete immutable corpus be released?
Can current wallet, mandate, execution, and outcome evidence be obtained?
Will frozen agent-aware features add intervention value over incumbent controls?
resolved_questions: The historical target is registry association, not fraud or verified autonomy.
The prior invariant explanation and submission-ready verdict do not survive adversarial audit.

decisions.summary: Withdraw fraud, human, banking, robustness, and deployment interpretations.
decisions.rationale: The corresponding constructs and outcomes are not observed.
Each element maps to a control point and falsifier.

decisions.summary: Fail closed on event identity, legacy labels, credentials, and operational decisions.
decisions.rationale: Silent compatibility would reproduce invalid claims.

approximations.description: Ignored local artifacts are used only to reconstruct prior arithmetic and defects.

propagated_uncertainties: Model-selection and graph-dependence uncertainty is not captured by nominal address bootstrap.
Registry owner supplies historical R evidence only; W,S,A,C,P,Y,H remain unknown.
blockers: provider-side rotation of the historical Dune credential
